title: Consultant, Data Quality Analytics
description:
**Consultant, Data Quality Analytics**

Data Science is all about breaking new ground to enable businesses to answer their most urgent questions. Pioneering massively parallel data-intensive analytic processing, our mission is to develop a whole new approach to generating meaning and value from petabyte-scale data sets and shape brand new methodologies, tools, statistical methods, and models. What’s more, we are in collaboration with leading academics, industry experts, and highly skilled engineers to equip our customers to generate sophisticated new insights from the biggest of big data.

**What you’ll achieve:**

As a Consultant, you will lead high-impact data quality programs that strengthen monitoring, validation, and defect remediation. You will automate checks, rollout policies, and measure improvements with quality KPIs across critical data products. You will collaborate with engineering and analytics teams to deliver scalable solutions and robust documentation.

Prove that the Knowledge & Intelligence layer's data can be trusted - and keep proving it. This is the data-trust and AI-readiness role for the governed knowledge spine that grounds AI agents on verified, provenance-backed facts. You trace where every fact came from, measure its quality and freshness, and turn those signals into the dashboards and evidence that show the layer meets its AI-ready data standard - continuously, not as a one-time sign-off. When trust, lineage, or quality drifts, you're the first to see it and the one who makes it visible to everyone else.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Consultant** on our **Data Quality Analytics** team.

**You will:**

* **Lineage & traceability.** Trace every served fact back to its source and transformations - the record that makes the layer explainable and auditable.
* **Quality signals.** Measure completeness, freshness, and schema drift across the layer's data products, and track them against their SLAs.
* **Active-metadata dashboards.** Build and own the dashboards (Splunk, Elastic / Kibana, SQL) that keep trust, freshness, and quality signals live for the engineering teams and for leadership.
* **AI-readiness evidence.** Assemble the conformance evidence that shows each data product meets the AI-ready data standard - at every phase gate, across all its dimensions.
* **Trust & compliance reporting.** Surface trust-tier coverage, provenance completeness, and PII / sensitivity-labeling status - the evidence audit and governance rely on. **Grounding discipline.** Nothing ships ungrounded; you flag anything that can't be traced back to a source.

**Take the first step towards your dream career**

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

**Essential Requirements**

* Strong data-analysis background - SQL-fluent, comfortable tracing data across systems and turning messy signals into clear, trustworthy views. Comes with 12-15 years of experience.
* Hands-on experience building report and monitoring dashboards (Splunk, Elastic / Kibana, Grafana, or similar). Experience with data quality, lineage, or data governance - measuring completeness, freshness, and drift, and evidencing it.
* Familiarity with data provenance and PII / sensitivity concepts - enough to report on them accurately.
* Comfort with knowledge graphs and semantic data - the substrate you'll trace and query (SPARQL a plus).
* Strong communication - you make trust and readiness legible to engineers, auditors, and leadership alike.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or related field.
* Certifications or vendor credentials for data quality or cloud data platforms.

**Who We Are**

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That’s why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we’re looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.  
  
Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. **Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy**.

Visit our ***Culture Code*** page to learn more about how we work and lead.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**

***#Siemens***

title: Business Analytics Analyst - Pyspark
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Technical / Tools Proficiency**

* **SQL**: Advanced querying (joins, window functions, CTEs, performance tuning) across large relational/Teradata/Hive data warehouses.
* **Python**: Data wrangling (pandas/numpy), automation scripting, statistical analysis, and visualization (matplotlib/seaborn).
* **PySpark**: Distributed data processing for large campaign/transaction datasets, working within Hadoop/Spark ecosystems.
* **SAS**: Base SAS and SAS Macros for large-scale data manipulation, campaign tagging, and reporting automation.

**Domain Knowledge – Banking & Card Products**

* Solid grounding in consumer banking/credit card business fundamentals: account lifecycle, interest income, fees, credit risk basics, and portfolio economics.
* Understanding of the credit card marketing lifecycle: acquisition, activation, usage, retention, and attrition.

**Campaign Analytics & Measurement**

* Design and execution of test-vs-control and champion-challenger frameworks for campaign effectiveness.
* Incrementality/lift analysis, response modeling, and uplift measurement.
* Campaign performance tracking: response rates, conversion, activation, spend, and profitability metrics.
* Experience building recurring performance dashboards/scorecards for campaign monitoring and post-campaign readouts.

**Statistical & Quantitative Analysis**

* Hypothesis testing, A/B testing methodology, and significance testing.
* Segmentation and targeting analysis (behavioral, demographic, risk-based).
* Regression/predictive modeling exposure (logistic regression, decision trees) for propensity/response scoring is a plus.
* Data quality checks, reconciliation, and root-cause/variance analysis.

**GenAI / Emerging Tools Familiarity**

* Working knowledge of Generative AI tools for analytics productivity — e.g., using LLM-based assistants for code generation/debugging (SAS/SQL/Python), documentation, and summarization of campaign results.
* Exposure to prompt engineering basics for querying enterprise GenAI platforms (e.g., internal chat/assist tools) to accelerate exploratory analysis and reporting.
* Awareness of GenAI use cases in marketing analytics: automated insight generation, natural-language querying of datasets and synthetic test data creation.
* Curiosity/adaptability to continuously evaluate and adopt new AI-assisted analytics tools as the function modernizes its toolkit.

**Communication**

* Ability to translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations for marketing/product stakeholders.
* Strong storytelling with data — clear presentation of insights to senior stakeholders (PowerPoint/Excel proficiency).
* Cross-functional collaboration with Marketing, Risk, Finance, and Technology teams.
* Project management skills to manage multiple concurrent campaign analytics requests under tight timelines.

**Behavioral Attributes**

* Independent ownership of analytics workstreams with minimal supervision, commensurate with 5-7 years of hands-on experience.
* Mentoring junior analysts and reviewing their analytical output.
* Strong attention to detail and controls mindset given regulatory sensitivity of rate-based offers.
* Proactive problem-solving and ability to work in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

**Experience Level:** 5-7 years of relevant analytics experience, preferably in banking/cards/financial services.

title: Data Analyst
description:

* Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field
* Experience with big data technologies and cloud platforms
* Machine learning and AI knowledge
* Previous experience in high-growth startup environments
* Familiarity with data modeling using statistical algorithms
* Experience building automated testing and monitoring systems

title: Business Analyst, Innovation lab
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.  
  
The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
* Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
* Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
* Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
* Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
* Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
* Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
* Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
* Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
* Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
* Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
* Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
* 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
* Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Business Services Analyst
description:
**About AQR Capital Management**

AQR is a global investment management firm built at the intersection of financial theory and practical application. We strive to deliver superior, long-term results for our clients by looking past market noise to identify and isolate what matters most, and by developing ideas that stand up to rigorous testing. description:

* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Optimize dashboard performance, query execution, and data pipeline efficiency.
* Work closely with Salesforce Administrators, Developers, Architects, and Business Stakeholders to deliver analytics solutions.
* Manage CRMA data ingestion from Salesforce objects, ensuring accurate mapping of fields and data types.Troubleshoot dashboard, dataset, and dataflow issues while maintaining data quality and governance.Follow best practices for CRMA development, deployment, and performance tuning.

**Your Profile**
----------------

* Required 5-8 years of experienced **Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA) Developer** to design, build, and optimize enterprise-level dashboards and data pipelines.
* Having experience in developing high-performance CRMA dashboards by customizing **JSON** structures, navigating CRMA’s unique architecture and limitations compared to tools like Tableau.
* Experienced in building advanced query using **SAQL** and **SQL** (utilizing CRMA-specific **cogrouping** ), managing data engineering via optimized **Data Syncs, Dataflows, and Recipes** , and enforcing strict row-level security using **Security Predicates** and **Sharing Inheritance** .
* To succeed, should have deep understanding of core Salesforce fundamentals, including objects, permission sets, data types, and how CRMA ingests platform data.
* **Primary Skills (Must-Have)** **CRMA Dashboarding** : Deep knowledge of CRMA dashboard limitations and capabilities vs. Tableau. **JSON Customization** : Hands-on experience editing dashboard JSON for advanced layouts and steps. **SAQL Expertise** : Advanced scripting in Salesforce Analytics Query Language for complex logic. **Data Pipelines** : Building, scheduling, and optimizing Recipes, Dataflows, and Data Syncs. **Recipe Optimization** : Ability to split data recipes by execution frequency to maximize performance. **Row-Level Security** : Implementing Security Predicates and Sharing Inheritance within CRMA.
* **Secondary Skills (Highly Preferred)** **Core Salesforce Architecture** : Solid grasp of standard/custom objects, fields, and permission sets. **CRMA Data Mapping** : Deep understanding of how Salesforce data types ingest and translate into CRMA. **SQL & Complex Joins** : Strong background in relational database joins to accelerate data modelling. **Cogrouping Mastery** : Understanding CRMA-specific multi-dataset joining techniques that differ from traditional SQL.

With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. title: Senior Data Mapping Analyst, Servicing Transaction Mgmt
description:
**Position Summary:**

The Servicing Transaction Management department is responsible for the loan boarding and deboarding process. This role relates to converting other servicers data to upload into Onity’s loan servicing system and subsequently validating the data uploaded versus the data and/or documents received for all newly boarded loans. This position is responsible for developing projects in the loan boarding and related applications for bulk and flow transfers. The Data Mapping Analyst will analyze and program boarding files, as well as participate in data mapping, researching issues and testing the application and data loads. This position requires strong analytical skills and technical knowledge to support the Loansphere Loan Boarding System (LLB) as well as the Onity proprietary Loan Boarding Tool. The Data Analyst will work closely with various parties including their immediate team, business units, prior servicers and other technical teams to coordinate data transformation. This role will also be responsible for implementing tools to support transfer efficiency, as well as keeping documentation updated and communicating changes to processes, procedures and tools.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensures that new loan programs or changes are incorporated into the boarding process.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The Marketing Solutions Consulting team helps clients understand the drivers of business performance and improve the effectiveness of their marketing investment through advanced analytics, including Marketing Mix Modelling. The India GCC team will work closely with colleagues across the UK and other global locations to deliver high-quality data, analytical and consulting work for major client engagements.
  
  
The team forms part of TransUnion’s global Marketing Solutions organisation and supports the delivery of data-driven insights that enable clients to make more informed commercial and marketing decisions. The role will report into the Marketing Solutions Consulting leadership team.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

The Senior Analyst role exists to take ownership of analytical workstreams within Marketing Solutions client engagements and ensure that work is delivered accurately, efficiently and to a consistently high standard. The individual will combine hands-on analysis with stakeholder communication, quality assurance and support for the development of junior colleagues.

* Translate business and client requirements into structured analytical questions, workplans, data requirements and delivery priorities.
* Take ownership of data collection, preparation, validation and analysis across assigned client workstreams.
* Investigate complex datasets to identify trends, anomalies, relationships and potential drivers of business performance.
* Review data inputs and analytical outputs, resolving discrepancies and ensuring that work is accurate, documented and ready for modelling or client delivery.
* Support Marketing Mix Modelling and other marketing effectiveness engagements by preparing model-ready data, reviewing inputs and outputs, and helping translate results into clear business implications.
* Develop forecasts, recommendations and strategic or tactical actions based on analytical findings, business context and market knowledge.
* Create clear, decision-focused outputs in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint for internal and client stakeholders.
* Explain complex analytical findings in straightforward language and contribute confidently to internal and client discussions.
* Manage assigned workstreams against agreed timelines, proactively identifying risks, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Review the work of junior analysts, provide practical coaching and help maintain consistent quality standards across the team.
* Collaborate with consulting, data, modelling, engineering and delivery colleagues across the India GCC, UK and wider global organisation.

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Approximately **two to three years of relevant experience** in analytics, data analysis, data-led consulting, research or a related field, including experience independently owning analytical tasks or workstreams.
* Strong quantitative and analytical knowledge, with the ability to structure complex problems, challenge assumptions and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
* A degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, engineering, data analytics or another quantitative discipline is preferred because the role requires independent interpretation of complex data and analytical outputs. Equivalent practical analytical experience will also be considered.
* Practical knowledge of data preparation, validation and quality-assurance frameworks, including experience identifying and resolving data-quality issues before delivery.
* Experience communicating analytical findings to colleagues or stakeholders. Previous client-facing experience is desirable because the role will contribute to discussions and help explain analytical outcomes.

### **Required Technical Skills**

* Advanced **Microsoft Excel** , including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation, reconciliation and quality-control processes.
* Strong **Microsoft PowerPoint** skills, with the ability to create clear, structured and decision-focused presentations.
* Practical experience working with large, complex and multi-source datasets.
* Working knowledge of **SQL, Structured Query Language** , or another data-querying or analytical tool.
* Ability to review analytical work, identify potential errors and communicate findings clearly in written and verbal English.

### **Preferred Skills**

We’re also looking for the preferred skills below. Whether you are proficient or could use some brushing up, we’re happy to support your career development and growth in:

* Experience with **Python** , **R** or another analytical programming language.
* Experience with visualisation tools such as **Microsoft Power BI** or **Tableau** .
* Exposure to Marketing Mix Modelling, marketing effectiveness, attribution, customer analytics or commercial performance analysis.
* Experience applying statistical methods such as regression, forecasting, hypothesis testing or time-series analysis.
* Experience reviewing the work of junior colleagues, coordinating analytical tasks or providing coaching and technical guidance.

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. title: Product Lead, Analytics
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Rippling recently launched Data Cloud, opening up a new opportunity to help customers understand and act on data across their business. By bringing together first-party, third-party, and customer-created data across HR, IT, finance, and external systems, Rippling can answer business questions that traditional analytics tools struggle to connect.

As Product Lead for Analytics, you will turn this extraordinary technical depth into simple, powerful products for enterprise and mid-market customers. You will own customer-facing analytics experiences and the shared capabilities that power analytics across Rippling—from intuitive reporting for business users to sophisticated analysis for advanced users.

This is a rare opportunity to define new AI-centric experiences beyond classic dashboards. You will build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, uncover insights, and proactively learn when meaningful events in their data need attention. AI will be the backbone of the features you ship—and a core part of how you build them.

Your core engineering team is based in India. You will work closely with engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and stakeholder teams across India and the USA to shape the product direction for a foundational part of Rippling’s Data Cloud and AI strategy.

### **What you’ll do**

* Own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for Analytics within Rippling’s Data Cloud.
* Define and build new experiences for how customers analyze data in the AI era, extending beyond classic reports and dashboards.
* Make sophisticated analysis intuitive for admins and business users while giving advanced users the depth and flexibility they need.
* Build agentic experiences that help customers investigate questions, explain trends, and proactively discover meaningful events in their data.
* Partner with your India-based engineering team and engineering, design, AI, Data Catalog, and product stakeholders across India and the USA to deliver trusted analytics across Rippling and external data.
* Work directly with enterprise and mid-market customers to understand their needs, win adoption, and measure customer value.
* Use AI extensively to accelerate discovery, prototyping, delivery, and product iteration.

### **What you’ll need**

* 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex B2B products.
* Experience building analytics, BI, data platforms, or adjacent products; experience with shared platform capabilities is valuable.
* Strong customer and UX judgment, with the ability to make sophisticated analysis intuitive without sacrificing power.
* Technical fluency in data modeling, querying, metrics, and permissions, and the ability to work closely with engineering on product trade-offs.
* AI fluency: an understanding of how to build reliable AI and agentic experiences, evaluate their quality, and use AI effectively in your own work.
* Strong systems thinking, clear communication, and the ability to drive execution across teams and geographies with high ownership.
* Alignment with Rippling’s leadership principles: We push the limits of possible, We challenge each other directly, and We go and see.

If you don’t necessarily meet all of the requirements listed here, we still encourage you to apply because skills can be used in lots of different ways, your life experience is equally important sometimes.

title: Manager Program Management VCA X, Visa Consulting & Analytics
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is a world leader in payments and technology, with over 259 billion payments transactions flowing safely between consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities in more than 200 countries and territories each year. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network, enabling individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive while driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

Make an impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa.

**Team Summary**

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.

Program Management is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the integrated planning, orchestration, and delivery management required to scale delivery across multiple use cases, teams, and geographies.

The role operates as one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Specialist & Consulting Delivery and Data & Analytics Delivery. It will form part of the VCA-X Leadership Team, and report directly to the Head of VCA-X.

**What a Manager, Program Management, VCA-X does at Visa:**

The Manager will coordinate the day-to-day operating processes that turn VCA-X priorities into disciplined execution, timely decisions, and consistent delivery across markets. The role will maintain plans and metrics, run governance cadences, administer demand intake, support quality and compliance controls, track automation and efficiency initiatives, and provide executive-assistant and administrative support to VCA-X leadership.

**Planning, Metrics & Execution Tracking**

* Support strategy and annual planning by translating priorities into detailed plans, milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines.
* Maintain scorecards and dashboards; track performance against agreed metrics and follow up on variances and actions.
* Produce accurate operating updates and decision-ready materials for management reviews.

**Governance, Quality & Compliance**

* Set up and run governance meetings and operating cadences, including agendas, pre-reads, minutes, action logs, and escalation tracking.
* Implement quality frameworks, checklists, review gates, documentation standards, and delivery controls.
* Monitor adherence to relevant policies and processes, maintain evidence, and coordinate remediation of identified gaps.

**Demand Intake & Delivery Coordination**

* Administer the demand intake pipeline, validate required information, coordinate assessments, and maintain status visibility.
* Support prioritization, resource planning, mobilization, and handoffs across multidisciplinary teams.
* Track delivery health, risks, issues, dependencies, and decisions; escalate blockers and drive actions to closure.

**Market & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate with Regional and market leaders to progress the VCA-X agenda, confirm demand, and align on next steps and commitments.
* Maintain stakeholder communications, action trackers, and decision records across a highly matrixed global environment.
* Support issue resolution by bringing together the right stakeholders and ensuring timely follow-through.

**Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provide executive-assistant support to VCA-X leadership, like calendar management, meeting scheduling, travel coordination, expense administration, coordination for site level initiatives, etc.
* Coordinate leadership meetings and events, prepare agendas and materials, manage logistics, and ensure actions and follow-ups are completed.
* Handle sensitive information with discretion and serve as a reliable coordination point for internal and external stakeholders.

**Automation & Efficiency Delivery**

* Maintain the pipeline of automation and process-improvement opportunities and coordinate prioritization and implementation.
* Track baseline performance, adoption, benefits, and delivery against agreed efficiency targets.
* Document and standardize improved processes, tools, templates, and ways of working.

**Why this is important to Visa**  
VCA-X depends on strong operating discipline to manage demand, coordinate delivery, maintain quality, and scale consistently. This role provides the execution backbone and management information needed to keep priorities moving and commitments on track.

**Qualifications**

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in program management, business operations, PMO, consulting operations, transformation, or professional-services delivery.
* Hands-on experience managing plans, milestones, scorecards, governance routines, risks, issues, and action tracking.
* Experience supporting demand intake, portfolio reporting, quality controls, compliance processes, and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong organization, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively across functions and geographies.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in shared services, centers of excellence, consulting, managed services, or global delivery operations.
* Exposure to automation, AI-enabled workflows, process improvement, or operational-efficiency programs.
* Knowledge of payments, financial services, or adjacent industries.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Workday Analyst
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

  

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

Solventum is seeking a highly motivated **Workday Analyst** to join our team and provide ongoing support for various Workday modules, including **HCM Core, Recruiting and Compensation** . The Workday Analyst will support 2 to 3 of the above modules and work closely with the US-based team to drive system initiatives, deliver improvements, and provide day-to-day support for Workday-related activities.

In this role, the analyst will be responsible for managing support tickets, resolving issues, assisting with system configurations, performing testing, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure the optimal use of Workday functionality. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of Workday, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work across time zones with the US team.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

  

* **Workday Recruiting:**
  + Serve as the first point of contact for the US-based team, addressing Workday-related support tickets and providing timely resolutions for any system issues.
  + Configure and maintain Workday Recruiting processes such as job requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview scheduling, offer management and Onboarding
  + Strong experience resolving configuration and functional issues across recruiting and onboarding modules, as well as touchpoints with other modules.
  + Collaborate with HR and Talent Acquisition teams to optimize recruiting workflows
  + Ensure the integrity of data across modules by monitoring system performance, investigating discrepancies, and implementing solutions.
  + Document and track issues, solutions, and improvements to provide a knowledge base for future support.
  Strong expertise in designing complex Workday calculated fields, with a solid understanding of business objects, data sources, and the appropriate placement of calculations.

  

* **Workday Compensation:**
  + Configure and maintain compensation plans, packages, eligibility rules, compensation grades and grade profiles, compensation basis and related reference data.
  + Support compensation transactions within staffing and worker lifecycle processes, including hire, change job, promotion and compensation change events.
  + Analyze compensation configuration issues, eligibility outcomes and process routing; recommend corrective actions and sustainable design improvements.
  + Collaborate with Compensation, HR and Payroll stakeholders to validate requirements, assess downstream impacts and support accurate, controlled deployment.
  Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Review Process, AIP and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

  

* **Collaboration with US-Based Team:**
  + Work closely with the US-based Workday team to understand business requirements, provide technical expertise, and ensure system configurations are aligned with organizational goals.
  + Assist in the implementation and execution of new features, functionality, and module upgrades by following established processes.
  Participate in cross-team meetings with the US team to align on priorities, project timelines, and best practices.

  

* **Workday Configuration & System Maintenance:**
  + Assist with the configuration and maintenance of Workday HCM, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, and Reporting modules based on business needs.
  + Support system updates, testing, and deployment activities to ensure smooth transitions during Workday upgrades or new releases.
  Ensure that workflows, business processes, and security roles are accurately configured to meet the needs of the business.

  

* **Project Support & Initiative Execution:**
  + Collaborate with the US-based team to drive global initiatives and provide support for ongoing projects, including process improvements and system enhancements.
  + Participate in system testing for new releases, changes, and enhancements, ensuring that all configurations meet business requirements.
  Assist with documenting project requirements, processes, and procedures to ensure proper system utilization.

  

* **Reporting & Data Analysis:**
  + Develop and maintain Workday reports and dashboards to support HR, payroll, and business requirements.
  + Assist with extracting, validating, and analyzing data to support business decision-making and compliance requirements.
  Collaborate with the reporting team to create custom reports or modify existing ones based on user feedback.

  

* **Training & Knowledge Sharing:**
  + Provide training and guidance to HR and business teams on Workday best practices, system functionality, and process improvements.
  Maintain up-to-date documentation on configurations, processes, and system changes to facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.

  

* **Continuous Improvement:**
  + Identify opportunities for process improvement and suggest enhancements to increase system efficiency and user satisfaction.
  Proactively address potential issues by analyzing trends, preparing solutions, and collaborating with the US team to resolve them.

  

**Your Skills and Expertise**

  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in Workday support or HRIS roles with exposure to multiple Workday modules.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in human resources, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Workday Expertise:** Solid experience supporting multiple Workday modules (HCM Core, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting).
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify system issues, resolve problems, and offer solutions.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Proficient in Workday’s reporting tools, Calc Fields, security configuration, and business process configuration.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across different time zones.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong problem-solving abilities to address support tickets, improve system functionality, and handle system issues efficiently.
* **Project Management:** Experience supporting system upgrades, new functionality, and process improvements.

  

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* **Workday Certifications:** Workday certifications in relevant modules (e.g., Workday HCM Core, Workday Compensation, Workday Recruiting) are highly desirable.
* **Global Workday Experience:** Experience in supporting global Workday implementations or managing cross-country configurations.
* **Reporting Expertise:** Strong experience in creating and maintaining custom reports and dashboards in Workday.

  

**Work location:**

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**

The Distribution Logistics Analyst is responsible for planning Aftermarket parts for New Product Introductions (NPI). This includes analyzing existing processes, implementing enhancements and quality gates to ensure Aftermarket readiness for successful NPI launches, and maintaining parts availability throughout the NPI lifecycle.

**What You Will Do:**

* The role involves close collaboration with Parts Product Specialists (PPS), Parts Product Analysts (PPA), and cross-functional teams to drive proactive actions that improve parts availability.
* In addition to strategic planning, the incumbent will perform tactical tasks such as managing work allocation, coordinating with cross-functional teams for issue resolution, and handling escalations related to NPI parts planning.
* The role also includes leading initiatives to build lean supply chain capabilities by applying lean methodologies.
* The Distribution Logistics Analyst will participate in global projects as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), working collaboratively with internal and external business partners to enhance the overall value chain.
* The incumbent will communicate effectively across stakeholders to resolve complex issues impacting parts availability and customer satisfaction. Key internal and external partners include Product Groups, Procurement, Inventory Management, Aftermarket Parts Supply, and Operations—ensuring a smooth transition and alignment across functions.

**Additional Information:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering with 8–10 years of relevant industry experience in Service Parts, Supply Chain, Inventory Management, and Procurement.
* Proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with global process partners; excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills are essential.
* Strong technical proficiency in SAS and Microsoft Office tools, including Power BI and PowerApps.
* Demonstrated customer focus and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment; capable of leading cross-functional projects.
* Solid understanding of statistical and problem-solving tools; hands-on experience with Six Sigma methodologies and Lean principles.
* Experience in managing complex supply chain challenges with a deep understanding of Caterpillar Parts business and systems.
* Willingness to work in US/UK shift timings to ensure adequate overlap with global stakeholders.

**DESIRED SKILLS:**

* Certified in APICS CPIM (Certified in Production and Inventory Management) or CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional).
* Six Sigma Green Belt certified, with practical experience in applying continuous improvement methodologies.

**What You Have:**

Business Process Improvement: Knowledge of business process improvement best practices and ability to use methods for identifying, evaluating, introducing and implementing more efficient approaches to performing business related activities.

* Gathers data for use in the analysis of business processes.
* Illustrates problems, opportunities and methods for improving existing business processes.
* Suggests ways to reduce variation and/or waste in processes.
* Helps evaluate what factors should be addressed in the change program.
* Participates in requirements analysis for process changes.

  
Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

  
Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Develops basic persuasive arguments.
* Discusses organizational culture around providing input on decisions.
* Uses active listening skills and probing techniques to surface opportunities to influence.
* Identifies who the decision makers are and how they receive information.
* Regularly presents ideas or suggestions to associates in persuasive terms.

  
Partnering for Clients' Success: Knowledge of and insight into clients' key objectives and ability to work and think alongside clients to achieve clients' current and future aspirations and successes.  
Level Basic Understanding:
  

* Explains the importance of one's own high quality work for clients' success; discusses quality standards that are established to obtain deliverables.
* Describes channels and techniques that used to understand client's expressed and unstated needs.
* Identifies a certain client's market shares, customer bases and business objectives.
* Cites examples of how to effectively build deep relationships with clients.

  
Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
* Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
* Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
* Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

  
Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
* Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
* Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
* Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
* Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

  
Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Raises awareness of potential bottlenecks and disruptions to the schedule.
* Breaks tasks into manageable steps that can be incorporated into a personal work plan.
* Escalates concerns over competing or conflicting priorities.
* Monitors progress continuously and adjusts tactics for handling situations on a case by case basis.
* Creates action plans that ensure the accomplishment of responsibilities.

  
Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes.  
Level Working Knowledge:
  

* Discusses considerations for integrating partner and supplier transactions.
* Recognizes software systems or components used to manage supply chain.
* Summarizes supply chain considerations for different types of products or components.

description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI-powered platform combines best-in-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.

**The Opportunity:**

The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer is the senior technical authority responsible for connecting governed enterprise data and business meaning with scalable analytics and artificial intelligence solutions. This role defines the architecture, standards, and engineering patterns for semantic models, governed metrics, AI-ready data products, machine learning operations, and generative AI consumption.

Operating at the intersection of Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science, Governance, and AI Platform Engineering, this role ensures that enterprise data, metrics, models, and knowledge assets can be reliably discovered, understood, deployed, monitored, and reused. The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership, guides complex implementations, and mentors engineers and analysts while remaining an individual contributor.

**What you’ll do…**

**Semantic Architecture & Governed Metrics**

* Define enterprise standards and reference patterns for semantic models, dimensional models, business metrics, KPIs, hierarchies, calculations, and reusable analytical assets.
* Architect semantic consumption patterns across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks Gold-layer data, and approved AI applications.
* Partner with business domain owners, analysts, and Data Governance to translate business concepts into consistent, governed definitions and analytical models.
* Lead design reviews for semantic models and analytical data products, balancing usability, reuse, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Ensure semantic assets are documented with appropriate metadata, lineage, ownership, and change controls.

**AI Engineering & MLOps**

* Define engineering standards for deploying, versioning, testing, monitoring, and governing machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Architect reusable MLand LLM patterns, including CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, evaluation, observability, rollback, and production support.
* Guide implementation of feature pipelines, model registries, inference workflows, retrieval pipelines, vectorized knowledge assets, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Partner with Data Scientists and AI product teams to move prototypes into secure, scalable, and supportable production services.
* Implement technical controls for traceability, reproducibility, model performance, data drift, responsible AI requirements, and operational reliability.

**AI-Ready Data & Knowledge Enablement**

* Design curated, governed data products and knowledge assets for predictive analytics, generative AI, copilots, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Define how structured data, enterprise metrics, metadata, documents, embeddings, and retrieval indexes are linked and consumed.
* Ensure AI applications use approved business definitions, metrics, access policies, and authoritative data sources.
* Collaborate with Architecture and Governance teams on ontology, glossary, metadata, lineage, classification, and policy integration.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Serve as the technical escalation point for complex semantic, analytics, MLOps, and AI engineering decisions.
* Create reference implementations, reusable frameworks, coding standards, and engineering playbooks.
* Mentor Senior Analytics & AI Engineers, Semantic Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists.
* Influence cross-functional roadmaps and communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.

Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend pragmatic adoption paths aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

**Who you are?**

* 10+ years of experience across analytics engineering, business intelligence, semantic modeling, data engineering, machine learning engineering, MLOps, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a principal-level technical leader or architect for enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions.
* Deep expertise in SQL, dimensional modeling, semantic model design, analytical performance optimization, and governed metric implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric semantic models, including DAX and enterprise-scale model design.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data and AI platform, including production data pipelines and model lifecycle capabilities.
* Experience designing or operating CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registries, monitoring, evaluation, and observability for ML or generative AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of generative AI patterns such as embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, prompt and model evaluation, and agent-based solutions.
* Strong understanding of metadata, lineage, data quality, access control, business glossary, and responsible AI principles.
* Proven ability to mentor technical professionals, lead architecture reviews, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and cloud observability tooling.
* Experience supporting enterprise Finance, GTM, Product, Customer, or Workforce analytics domains.
* Experience establishing reusable semantic or AI platform capabilities in a federated operating model.

**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Securities Quantitative Analytics Senior Manager (Executive Director level)** to lead Front Office quantitative model development within the Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) organization. The role is responsible for building and managing quantitative analytics teams that develop pricing, risk, trading, and analytics solutions across multiple asset classes including Interest Rates, Credit, FX, Equities, Commodities, and XVA/Counterparty Risk. This position partners closely with Trading, Structuring, Risk, and Technology teams to deliver scalable quantitative solutions that support the firm's strategic pricing and risk platforms.

The role requires in-depth quantitative modeling experience in one or more of these asset classes, combined with a strong foundation in derivatives pricing, financial mathematics, numerical methods, and model implementation.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop teams of quantitative analysts, researchers, and managers while fostering a high-performance and talent-driven culture.
* Utilize advanced quantitative, statistical, and technological techniques to solve complex business and market challenges.
* Develop and enhance automated trading algorithms, derivatives pricing models, and empirical models to support trading, risk management, and market analysis.
* Define, interpret, and implement policies, procedures, and governance standards related to quantitative analytics and model development.
* Analyze risk exposures and structure transactions to meet client, business, and market objectives.
* Establish strategic direction and execute initiatives for the Securities Quantitative Analytics function, ensuring delivery of high-impact business outcomes.
* Design and develop advanced quantitative platforms, electronic trading tools, parallel computing architectures, and high-performance analytical solutions.
* Partner with Trading, Structuring, Risk, Technology, and senior leadership teams to drive quantitative innovation and business value.
* Serve as a key quantitative advisor to Front Office trading desks, supporting pricing, valuation, hedging, and risk management activities.
* Influence stakeholders across all organizational levels and effectively communicate complex quantitative concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Manage financial and human capital resources to achieve organizational objectives and strategic priorities.
* Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence across quantitative analytics platforms and processes.
* Build and maintain a strong culture of collaboration, leadership, accountability, and professional development within the team.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 7+ years of experience in quantitative analytics, quantitative research, derivatives modeling, or Front Office quantitative development.
* 3+ years of people management or leadership experience.
* 7+ years of strong quantitative modeling expertise in one or more asset classes such as Interest Rates, Credit, FX, Equities, Commodities, or XVA.
* Deep understanding of derivatives pricing, risk management, financial mathematics, stochastic calculus, Monte Carlo simulation, numerical methods, and optimization techniques.
* 7+ years strong programming skills in C++ and/or Python with experience implementing production-grade quantitative models.
* 4+year of experience developing pricing models, risk models, analytics libraries, or large-scale quantitative platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* 3+ years of experience in interest rate modeling, curve construction, and pricing of interest rate products.
* Expertise in optimization-based model development and performance tuning.
* Experience working within Agile software development environments.
* Ability to support trading desks and communicate complex quantitative concepts to business stakeholders

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* Proven experience in the design, development, and implementation of quantitative models for interest rate risk management, trading strategies, and pricing of fixed income and interest rate products.
* Strong expertise in yield curve construction, optimization techniques, and quantitative model development within Front Office environments.
* Experience collaborating with Quantitative Research, Trading, Risk, and Technology teams to develop and deploy scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, performance optimization, and implementation of production-grade quantitative platforms.
* Ability to effectively communicate complex quantitative concepts to business stakeholders, project teams, and senior management.
* Experience delivering high-quality software solutions and technical documentation within Agile and SDLC frameworks.
* Proven ability to support trading desks by providing model expertise, troubleshooting quantitative issues, and enhancing deployed analytics frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and partner across global teams and business functions.

**Job Expectations:**

  

* Lead the development, enhancement, implementation, and validation of quantitative models across Interest Rates, Credit, FX, Equities, Commodities, and XVA/Counterparty Risk.
* Provide deep quantitative expertise in one or more asset classes while applying modeling methodologies across a broad range of products and business lines.
* Partner closely with Front Office Traders, Structurers, and Quantitative Researchers to solve complex pricing, valuation, hedging, and risk management challenges.
* Develop and enhance derivatives pricing models, quantitative analytics libraries, and risk methodologies utilized within production trading platforms.
* Design, calibrate, and maintain market models involving yield curves, discount curves, volatility surfaces, correlation frameworks, and credit curves.
* Research, evaluate, and implement advanced quantitative techniques to improve model accuracy, robustness, computational efficiency, and risk calculations.
* Drive the development of scalable and high-performance quantitative solutions supporting trading and risk management activities.
* Collaborate with global Quant, Risk, and Technology teams to accelerate the firm's strategic quantitative platform initiatives.
* Ensure high standards of model governance, validation support, documentation, and regulatory compliance.
* Contribute to innovation and continuous improvement in quantitative research, model development, and analytical capabilities supporting Front Office businesses.

**Posting End Date:**

26 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Functional Summary

The CS Business Intelligence and Analytics (BI&A) team has a simple mission: we turn massive amounts of data into robust tools and actionable insights that drive business value and provide best in class experience to our clients, internally and externally. Our team works to support Go to Market Services (GTMS) teams by building consolidated, strategic and scalable operational and analytics infrastructure for Visa core products, value added services, and internal processes.

Responsibilities

The Analyst will be responsible for owning the analytic function for GTMS business and performance metrics, both periodic and ad hoc. Specific activities may include:

  

* Become the subject expert on all things related to GTMS business reporting
* Own data and processes for daily, monthly, and quarterly executive reporting suites, ensuring timely and accurate delivery
* Coordinate across product and metric owners to define key metrics and follow-up on any outliers or deviations
* Create and maintain performance and monitoring dashboards around internal GTMS business metrics, including sales data, client care case performance, and CRM metrics
* Identify and resolve inconsistencies and data quality issues
* Serve as a liaison to strategic business partners to understand their needs and propose and build fit for purpose solutions
* Perform periodic and ad hoc end-to-end analyses to identify operational and business opportunities to drive Best in Class performance
* Work with stakeholders to understand the root problems, define analytical objectives and formalize data requirements for various types of dashboards and analyses
* Design and launch robust and intuitive Tableau and Power BI dashboards supporting best in class money movement client experience
* Create and present analytic deliverables to colleagues in the analytics team, other internal stakeholders with varying degrees of analytical and technical expertise
* Distill massive amounts of data across disparate data sources into efficient functional data repositories in a Big Data environment
* Independently perform analysis to derive insights and render robust, thoughtful results
* Develop presentations of complex data and content for clients and stakeholders in an accurate, understandable, and engaging manner

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* 3 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 1 year of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 2 years of relevant experience with a PhD
* Understanding of payments and operational client care functions
* Able to utilize AI tools without losing the “human touch” and domain expertise
* Expert proficiency in data visualization including Tableau, Power BI, and PowerPoint
* Big Data skills including SQL and ETL experience
* Functional knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, and/or Shell Scripting to support automation and data cleansing
* Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics or other ERP/CRM tools
* Proficiency manipulating data from a variety of sources - Big data skills (Hadoop, Hive, Spark) and/or SQL skills required. Able to ‘talk data’ with technology partners
* Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills with the ability to summarize complex topics into easy to understand pieces
* Proficient in all MS Office applications
* Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
* Ability to interact and manage stakeholders globally and across time-zones
* Visa experience or knowledge of the payments industry

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
